run_MRPCEval: run the MRPCEval class to evaluate paraphrase detection on the MRPC dataset using sentence embeddings
create_MRPCEval: create an MRPCEval instance with a task path and optional seed to load MRPC train and test data
load_MRPC_file: load an MRPC TSV file and return a dictionary with sentence pairs A, B and binary labels
prepare_MRPC_samples: prepare MRPC sentence samples for embedding by passing train and test sentence pairs to a prepare function
run_MRPC_evaluation: run MRPC paraphrase detection evaluation and return dev accuracy, test accuracy, and F1 score
